title: Sied van Riel - Stealing Time (Radio Edit) (Feat. Nicole McKenna)

lines.l: I think your love is gone, but there's no one there to answer my call
Give it all to the journey, give it all to you
And I thought you'd make me home
I'm lost, I think it's time for me to let go
Holding on to nothing, let the world pass by
I think it's time for me to let go
I try not to, I'm still in time
And with the world that's by
